domains.name: Computational Reproducibility
domains.scope: Make computational artifacts traceable, rerunnable, and comparable without hidden environmental or data dependencies.

domains.name: Audio and Music Production Planning
domains.scope: Plan recording, editing, arrangement, review, and delivery decisions from supplied audio evidence and creative constraints.

domains.name: Video Editing Decisions
domains.scope: Plan and review video structure, continuity, sound-image relationships, accessibility, and delivery from supplied footage and briefs.

domains.name: Deployment and Operations Planning
domains.scope: Prepare deployments, recovery, capacity checks, and operational handoffs with explicit evidence and rollback boundaries.

domains.name: Defensive Security Review
domains.scope: Review authorized system evidence, access boundaries, exposure, and recovery preparation without performing intrusive security actions.

domains.name: API Contract Engineering
domains.scope: Define and test request, response, retry, pagination, and compatibility contracts for application interfaces.

domains.name: Software Verification Design
domains.scope: Design focused tests for behavior, boundaries, state transitions, regressions, and reproducible failures.

domains.name: Kaggle Competition Workflows
domains.scope: Prepare competition experiments, submissions, collaboration records, and reproducible handoffs under verified current competition rules.

domains.name: Hackathon Delivery
domains.scope: Scope, organize, demonstrate, and hand off time-bounded hackathon projects under supplied event requirements.

domains.name: Model Evaluation Design
domains.scope: Design and interpret model evaluations that reflect deployment conditions and explicit decision costs.

domains.name: Feature and Label Pipelines
domains.scope: Design feature transformations and label construction with prediction-time availability and reproducible fitting boundaries.

domains.name: Data Pipeline Design
domains.scope: Specify reliable ingestion, transformation, recovery, and data-contract behavior for bounded pipelines.

domains.name: Analytical Reasoning and Metrics
domains.scope: Define and diagnose analytical measures, comparisons, uncertainty, and interpretation using supplied data.

domains.name: Dataset Intake and Documentation
domains.scope: Assess dataset suitability, provenance, documentation, and release readiness before downstream use.

domains.name: Dataset Quality Diagnostics
domains.scope: Diagnose concrete dataset integrity failures and define evidence-based repair checks.
